breakdown.description: Lumped-capacitance method is requested even though Bi=5 violates the small-Biot validity condition.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that Bi=5 violates the lumped-capacitance validity condition (Bi < 0.1) and switched to a spatially resolved transient conduction model (series solution with radial dependence). This matches the ground truth's guidance that for Bi≈5, a spatially resolved transient conduction model should be used instead of lumped capacitance.
